verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes an official MCP server at mcp.sentry.dev, confirmed by a probe. It connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading docs and managing projects. The docs describe setting it up for use inside agent conversations, and pricing lists MCP access on the entry tier. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting successfully, and detailed setup/auth/transport documentation in the evidence.
